name: room
text: Room opened — goal: improve: Self-improvement: review prompts/engines/routing/own-code; auto-apply safe changes; pitch

name: Sprocket
text: Run PR-Agent on *all* PRs—open and merged—for two weeks. It catches edge cases missed by humans and automated checks, improving review consistency. The trade-off is temporary noise in PR comments, but the data quality gain outweighs it.

name: Gauge
text: PR-Agent on *all* PRs risks normalizing noise—reviewers will ignore *all* comments, including real issues, once the false-positive flood starts. Shadow mode trains reviewers to filter noise *now*; rolling it out site-wide without proving it catches *meaningful* misses first is gambling with review quality. Settle it: run PR-Agent on *only* the 20% most error-prone PRs by historical data for two weeks, measure the signal-to-noise ratio, then decide.
